environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'frontend-apps'. Backend services in 'internal-services' namespace. Envoy sidecar injected but running in permissive mode (PERMISSIVE mTLS). No Istio AuthorizationPolicy applied. Backend service at backend-api.internal-services.svc.cluster.local:8080 uses gunicorn with default HTTP parsing. Network policies allow all inter-namespace traffic.
